questionText: A sum of Rs. 6,400 amounts to Rs. 8,100 in 8 years at a certain rate of interest, compounded annually. Find the amount received after 4 years when Rs. 2,240 are invested at same rate of compound interest (compounded annually).
solution:
For first case:
A/P = 8100/6400 = 81/64 = (3/2)^4? Actually (3/2)^4 = 81/16, so not that.
Observe:
8100/6400 = 1.265625 = (9/8)^2 over 8 years means 4-year factor = 9/8.
Thus amount after 4 years on Rs.2240 = 2240 × 9/8 = Rs.2520.

questionText: A sum is being lent at 10 percent per annum compound interest (compounding annually). What is the ratio of amount at the end of first year to the amount at the end of second year?
solution:
Let principal = P
Amount after 1 year = 1.1P
Amount after 2 years = 1.1 × 1.1P = 1.21P
Ratio = 1.1P : 1.21P = 110 : 121 = 10 : 11

questionText: The compound interest on a sum at 18% p.a. for 1 1/2 years, compounded yearly, is Rs. 2,862. Find the principal.
solution:
For 1 1/2 years with annual compounding:
First year amount = P × 1.18
For next half year, interest is simple on amount of first year:
Amount = P × 1.18 × (1 + 18/2/100)
= P × 1.18 × 1.09
= P × 1.2862
So CI = P(1.2862 - 1) = 0.2862P
Given 0.2862P = 2862
P = 2862 / 0.2862 = 10000

questionText: A sum is being lent at 12.5 percent per annum compound interest (compounding annually). What is the ratio of amount at the end of first year to the amount at the end of second year?
solution:
Rate = 12.5% = 1/8.
Amount after first year = P × 9/8
Amount after second year = P × 9/8 × 9/8 = P × 81/64
Ratio = 9/8 : 81/64 = 72 : 81 = 8 : 9.

questionText: Rs. 4000 is invested in a scheme of compound interest (compounding annually) at the annual rate of 15 percent. What will be the difference between compound interest of second year and third year?
solution:
Amount after 1 year = 4000 × 1.15 = 4600
CI of 2nd year = 15% of 4600 = 690
Amount after 2 years = 4600 + 690 = 5290
CI of 3rd year = 15% of 5290 = 793.5
Difference = 793.5 - 690 = 103.5
conceptTested: The interest for the (n+1)th year is calculated on the amount at the end of the nth year.
